findings.summary: latestBacklog() keys off the most recent FAILED run instead of excluding failed runs.
findings.mechanism: The subquery `SELECT MAX(id) FROM runs WHERE status = 'failed'` selects the newest run whose status IS 'failed' — the opposite of the stated intent to exclude failed runs. If no run has ever failed, this returns NULL and the WHERE run_id = NULL match returns zero rows, so the gauge would always be empty even after a successful run with real backlog. If a failed run exists, the gauge keys off that failed run's (empty) rows instead of the last real observation, clearing data it should preserve.
